C-R9-GOVERNANCE-SIMPLIFY-327.Summary: Simplify design, CI and GRACE governance so ordinary development proves the product once on the PR head and repeats only a short smoke after merge, while retaining risk-scoped and release safety guarantees.
C-R9-GOVERNANCE-SIMPLIFY-327.Problem: The repository already has one compact ordinary CI and one universal release workflow, but three residual rules still add ritual without a new guarantee: main pushes rerun the complete PR suite, GRACE reruns its contract after merge, and design governance validates exact wording, an exact reference count and a formal five-role order instead of durable design contracts.

Goals.Goal: Run locked install, check, docs, unit/integration and smoke once for pull requests; run only locked install plus smoke on a merged main commit.
Keep GRACE automatic on governed pull requests and manual diagnostics, but remove automatic post-merge GRACE duplication.

Make design governance validate durable source-of-truth artifacts, reduced-motion/no-motion safety and a usable reference catalog without exact style slogans, exact demo counts or mandatory specialist choreography.
Preserve the existing version-neutral build-once Release workflow and prove its install/update/rollback guarantees through existing regression tests rather than rewriting it.
Close only backlog items and PRs whose obsolescence is confirmed by current main, merged PRs or published GitHub releases.

Constraints.Constraint: Branch protection continues to require only the ordinary PR check named Проверка.
Risk-scoped database, auth/ACL, installer/update/offline and release verification guarantees are not weakened.
No polling, workflow_run fan-out, version-specific workflow or archive-only follow-up PR is introduced.
Release workflow bytes remain unchanged unless a failing regression proves a necessary correction.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Make full browser/offline/release regression mandatory for ordinary feature PRs.
Change release publication, artifact format, installer or rollback implementation.
Close open product work merely because it is old.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: On pull_request and workflow_dispatch, Проверка contains locked install, check, docs, npm test and smoke; on push main the workflow executes only locked install and npm run smoke.
GRACE has pull_request path selection for .grace/** and workflow_dispatch, but no automatic push main trigger or post-merge contract/database jobs.

Design governance passes when semantic design/motion artifacts are intact even if Apple-inspired wording changes, the catalog count changes, or a UI GRACE plan does not enumerate five specialist task titles in a fixed order.

Design governance still fails when a required design/skill source disappears, the motion contract loses reduced-motion/no-motion guidance, the catalog loses its reference boundary, or the catalog has no usable mappings.
CI regression proves branch protection still requires only Проверка and forbids browser/offline/systemd/backup fan-out in ordinary CI.
Existing release regression still proves one explicit version-neutral workflow, exact-main preflight, build-once artifact and install/update/forced-rollback path.
Issues 266, 269, 270, 273, 286, 288 and PRs 298, 299 are closed or explicitly retained only after GitHub evidence is checked.
npm run check, docs check, full ordinary project tests, smoke and GRACE contract/scope pass on one exact PR head.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Exact-head project CI plus GRACE prove that PR verification remains complete, post-merge work is reduced to smoke, design safety remains semantic, release guarantees remain unchanged and no new orchestration fan-out is introduced.
